Phone: +91 9942203994 | Linkedin | Github | Email: roobak.s2024ece@sece.ac.in 
Designed and validated synthesizable Verilog RTL for combinational and sequential systems (counters, FSMs,
display controllers) on Xilinx Artix-7 FPGAs (Basys 3, Nexys A7). Managed timing-aware .xdc constraints, pin
mapping, and clock discipline across simulation-to-hardware flow, with real-time I/O testing using switches,
LEDs, and 7-segment displays. Used ILA and VIO for on-chip signal debugging and silicon-level visibility.
Tools: Xilinix Vivado, Verilog
Core Concepts: Circuit Analysis, Analog Electronics, Digital Electronics, Semiconductor Devices, CMOS Concepts
Programming: Verilog HDL, C
Development Boards: Basys-3, PYNQ-Z2, Nexys A7
Tools: Cadence Virtuoso, Xilinx Vivado, ModelSim, EDA Playground, LTspice
DIGITAL SYSTEM PROTOTYPING USING FPGA’s - NIELIT CALICUT DEC 2025
PROJECTS
Designed and implemented CMOS layouts for Inverter, NAND, and NOR gates using Cadence Virtuoso, performing
transistor-level PMOS and NMOS placement with proper well formation and routing. Ensured DRC-clean layouts by
adhering to CMOS design rules and technology constraints, with focus on symmetry, optimal area utilization, and structured
power routing (VDD/GND), strengthening understanding of the physical design and verification flow.
STANDARD CELL-BASED CMOS LOGIC LAYOUT JULY 2026
FPGA-Based Smart Power Load Management System DEC 2025
Designed a smart load-shielding management system using FSM-based control to monitor and regulate electrical load in real
time on the Nexys A7 FPGA, automatically switching between normal, warning, shielding, and recovery states with threshold-
based transitions and hysteresis to prevent overload and rapid state changes. A manual override mode allows push-button-
controlled load adjustments, while LEDs and a seven-segment display show real-time load status and system state.
ACHIEVEMENTS
DVCon India 2026 Design Contest - Proposal shortlisted from a national pool of entries, advancing to Stage 2 
FOSSEE eSim - Research Migration Contributor, FOSSEE eSim Initiative, IIT Bombay 
Freshathon 2025 - Stood out among second-year teams across all departments, securing 1st place and a ₹ 5,000 cash prize 
Simulathon 2025 - Selected among final 50 teams (430+ participants) after Olympiad Quiz and Idea Submission rounds
creat-a-thon 2024 - Secured 1st place among 15+ competing teams
SelfE Hackathon 2024 - Secured 2nd place among 100+ competing teams 
Freshwarite 2024 - Won 3rd place in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering
CODING PROFILE
NPTEL - Design Thinking - A Primer | Top 5% among 7204 candidates | Elite+Silver | 86% 
FOSSEE, IIT BOMBAY - eSim Research Migration Project
Series Crystal Oscillator Design Using 2N2219 BJT
ECG Analog Front-End with Wilson Central Terminal and Multi-Stage Filtering
MAR 2026
SEP 2025
OCT 2025
SMART ROOM OCCUPANY SYSTEM MAR 2026
Designed a bidirectional Smart Room Occupancy System using IR break-beam sensors and an FSM-based Verilog HDL
design to detect entry/exit direction and maintain a real-time occupancy counter. Synthesized, verified, and deployed the
design on a PYNQ-Z2 FPGA via Xilinx Vivado, incorporating capacity-threshold alerts and support for energy management
integration (automated lighting/ventilation control).
